# Trade Bot

Trade Bot is an automated paper-trading prototype built for the NDAX exchange, currently paused. The original used rule-based example strategies in simulation mode, with real public prices, a virtual 10,000 CAD portfolio, simulated 0.2% fees and a complete journal of simulated trades. No real money was ever at stake.

This listing now installs a packaged Muse skill, not the running bot. The skill explains the original design and its configurable thresholds, reports the small preserved test record with its limits, and guides you step by step in designing your own paper-trading sandbox. It does not restart Trade Bot, ask for exchange credentials, or place real trades. It is a Skill Harbor house build, free to use under the proprietary Skill Harbor House License v1.0, all rights reserved.
